M10 — 2026-10-08
Right after `npm publish`, `sofar upgrade <ver>` can fail with ETARGET "No matching version found" for up to ~5 minutes of registry lag (seen on rc.3 and rc.3 of 0.35, 2026-10-07/09). It is not a failed publish: poll `npm view <pkg>@<ver> dist.shasum --prefer-online` for all six packages, then upgrade.
